name: Why is proper roof flashing so important in areas like DFW?

mainEntity.name: Why is proper roof flashing so important in areas like DFW?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper roof flashing is crucial in the DFW area due to its exposure to varied and sometimes severe weather conditions, including heavy thunderstorms, hail, and high winds. These elements can quickly exploit any weaknesses in flashing, leading to significant water damage. Well-installed and maintained flashing directs water away from vulnerable roof areas, preventing leaks that can cause structural damage, mold growth, and costly repairs, especially around complex roof features common in local architecture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper flashing is vital in DFW due to severe weather like thunderstorms and hail, preventing leaks that can cause structural damage and costly repairs by diverting water from vulnerable roof areas.
